summary: Independent LLM review approves the exact frozen statement and self-contained proof. Complementary rows form a strict vertex-cap fan, and each singleton region is exactly the stated triangle with area h_i times its opposite-edge overlap. Two singleton areas at least one quarter force the omitted barycentric coordinate to be strictly smallest. Choosing a smallest-coordinate index therefore either gives an immediately covering pair with own-cap sum greater than one, or makes that index uniquely potentially qualifying. In the latter case the exact edge ratio exceeds 1/(4h), the cap formula h*t^2/(t-L) is strictly increasing up to t=1, and the resulting complementary area bounds again give own-cap sum greater than one. Every qualifying source hits the selected pair, including boundary-support equality. The strict final score greater than one half follows from v>0, also when all source weights vanish.
